summary.business_type: Travel & Tourism - Niche destination guide (Potala Palace & Lhasa, Tibet)
top_findings: No responsive images - mobile users download full desktop-size images
No author bylines or About page - E-E-A-T gap for YMYL-adjacent content
No Organization schema - publisher entity not established
Gallery images lack width/height - causing CLS
quick_wins: Fix hero image alt text (1 min)
Add lastmod to all sitemap entries (5 min)
Add fetchpriority=high to hero image (1 min)
Add FAQPage schema to 3 missing pages (10 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt properly configured with sitemap reference
XML sitemap with 11 URLs and proper priorities
Canonical URLs on all pages
Clean semantic URL structure
Skip-to-content accessibility link

findings.title: Inconsistent lastmod coverage in sitemap
findings.description: Only 3 of 11 sitemap entries include lastmod dates. Search engines rely on this field for crawl prioritization.
findings.recommendation: Add lastmod to all 11 sitemap entries, using the build date for static content.

findings.title: No hreflang tags
findings.description: English-only site targeting international visitors lacks hreflang tags to signal intentional single-language targeting.
findings.recommendation: Add hreflang='en' and hreflang='x-default' tags.

findings.title: Security headers not verified
findings.description: Headers like HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options cannot be verified in static build. Must configure at hosting/CDN level.
findings.recommendation: Verify security headers after deployment.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Substantive long-form content on every page (1500-3000+ words)
Strong factual basis with specific numbers, dates, and statistics
Excellent internal linking between related pages
Well-crafted FAQ sections with practical answers
Testimonials with specific visitor names and dates

findings.title: No author bylines or credentials
findings.description: Zero indication of who wrote or reviewed the content. For YMYL-adjacent travel content (high-altitude restricted area), Google E-E-A-T guidelines strongly favor demonstrated expertise.
findings.recommendation: Add author names and credentials to each article. Create author bio pages.

findings.title: No About page
findings.description: No page explaining who operates the guide, their qualifications, or editorial standards.
findings.recommendation: Create an About page with site ownership, travel credentials, and editorial policy.

findings.title: Testimonials lack external verification
findings.description: Visitor testimonials include names and dates but no links to original review sources or Review schema markup.
findings.recommendation: Link testimonials to original sources and add Review structured data.

findings.title: No last-reviewed dates on health content
findings.description: Altitude advice and medical recommendations (Diamox, acclimatization) lack review dates.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Last reviewed: [date]' to sections with medical/health content.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Well-crafted title tags within optimal length (50-65 chars)
Unique meta descriptions on every page
Complete OG and Twitter card tags on all pages
Clean heading hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3)
Visual breadcrumb navigation on sub-pages

findings.title: Hero image alt text contains HTML break tag
findings.description: Hero image has alt text containing a br tag rendered as literal text. Screen readers will read the markup.
findings.recommendation: Replace with plain text: 'Potala Palace overlooking Lhasa — Tibet''s Crown Jewel'

findings.title: Hotels page title missing year freshness signal
findings.description: The hotels page title lacks '2026' while most other pages include the year.
findings.recommendation: Update to 'Hotels with Potala Palace View | Best Places to Stay 2026'

findings.title: Repeated H2 patterns across pages
findings.description: Multiple pages use identical H2 headings like 'Frequently Asked Questions'.
findings.recommendation: Vary H2 headings with page-specific keywords for better topical signals.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: TouristAttraction schema on homepage with geo coordinates
BreadcrumbList schema on all 11 pages
FAQPage schema on 8 of 11 pages
Article schema on all 10 content pages with datePublished/dateModified
HowTo schema on Visit page with 8 steps
Reusable StructuredData.astro component for consistency

findings.title: No Organization schema
findings.description: A site claiming to be the most complete English-language guide should establish a publisher entity via Organization schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema with name, url, logo, and description.

findings.title: No Review schema on testimonials
findings.description: Three visitor testimonials are perfect Review schema candidates. This could generate star ratings in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Add Review schema markup to homepage testimonials with reviewRating and author.

findings.title: Article schema missing author and publisher
findings.description: All Article blocks lack author (Person) and publisher (Organization) references recommended by Google.
findings.recommendation: Add author and publisher properties to Article schema once bylines and Organization are established.

findings.title: 3 pages missing FAQPage schema
findings.description: History, best-time, and lhasa-attractions pages have FAQ content but no FAQPage structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema to these 3 pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Minimal CSS: 34KB total (well under 50KB critical CSS budget)
No JavaScript frameworks - only vanilla JS (~2KB)
WebP image format on all images
Lazy loading on gallery and content images
No external font files or third-party scripts

findings.title: Hero image is 219KB
findings.description: The above-the-fold hero image is the LCP bottleneck. At 219KB with no preload, estimated mobile LCP is 4-6 seconds vs the 2.5s target.
findings.recommendation: Compress hero image to 100KB. Add preload link and fetchpriority='high'.

findings.title: No responsive images
findings.description: No srcset or picture elements. Mobile users download the same full-size images as desktop. Total page weight estimated at 1.8MB.
findings.recommendation: Generate 400w, 800w, 1200w variants and use img srcset with sizes attribute.

findings.title: Gallery images total ~1.25MB
findings.description: Six gallery images at 165-275KB each even with lazy loading create excessive payload.
findings.recommendation: Compress gallery images to 100KB each. Combined savings: ~650KB.

findings.title: Gallery images lack width/height
findings.description: Missing explicit dimensions cause Cumulative Layout Shift as images load.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all gallery img elements.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Extensive FAQ content with FAQPage schema on 8 pages
Clear factual statements with specific numbers
Well-structured heading hierarchy for LLM parsing
BreadcrumbList schema for site architecture understanding
Article schema with freshness dates

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Missing llms.txt file at site root. This file gives LLM crawlers a structured index of key pages, increasingly important as AI search grows.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with site description and links to all 11 pages with summaries.

findings.title: No explicit AI crawler rules
findings.description: robots.txt has no specific rules for GPTBot, Claude-Web, Google-Extended, or PerplexityBot.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit Allow directives for major AI crawlers.

findings.title: No Key Facts summary blocks
findings.description: Long articles lack concise summary boxes that are prime candidates for featured snippets and AI Overview extraction.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Key Facts' or 'At a Glance' boxes with 4-6 bullet points at the top of long articles.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images in WebP format
Descriptive, keyword-relevant alt text on every image
Gallery images include visible captions
Dedicated OG image for social sharing
Images are relevant and well-chosen

findings.title: No responsive image variants
findings.description: Zero srcset or picture usage. All devices receive the same full-size image.
findings.recommendation: Generate responsive variants and implement srcset with sizes attribute.

findings.title: Image file sizes too large
findings.description: Images range from 166-275KB. Target for travel site: 80-120KB.
findings.recommendation: Recompress all images at WebP quality 75.

findings.title: Gallery images missing dimensions
findings.description: Gallery images lack explicit width/height attributes, causing CLS.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height to all gallery img elements.

findings.title: No image sitemap
findings.description: No dedicated image XML sitemap for Google Images discovery.
findings.recommendation: Generate image sitemap using Astro build hooks.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add responsive images with srcset (3-4 hours)
Compress all images to target sizes (30 min)
Add width/height to gallery images (15 min)
Create About page with author credentials (2-3 hours)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add Organization schema (15 min)
Add Review schema to testimonials (30 min)
Create llms.txt file (10 min)
Add preload and fetchpriority to hero image (5 min)
Add author bylines to articles (30 min)
Add FAQPage schema to 3 missing pages (20 min)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add Key Facts summary boxes to long articles
Add source citations for factual claims
Add last-reviewed dates to health/altitude content
Link testimonials to original sources
Add AI crawler directives to robots.txt
Vary H2 headings across pages

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Deploy and run Lighthouse for real CWV measurements
Set up Google Search Console
Add image sitemap
Monitor AI Overview appearances
Consider hreflang tags for future multilingual expansion
